description: On 21 September I took a Ryde from East Coast Park to Buona Vista MRT. The upfront estimate was about S$26.88 but I was charged S$30.40. The trip was about 3.2 km longer than the recommended route. The driver messaged about traffic, but I still think the extra charge is unfair. I am requesting a refund of the excess fare.
